correctness.rationale: For a solid right circular cone with h/r=t>0, direct volume/surface/support integration gives normalized intrinsic volumes V0=1,V1=m(t)=π+t−atan(t), V2=π(1+√(1+t²))/2,V3=πt/3. The reciprocal monic cubic has Q=m²−3πs/2, H=2m³−9πms/2+9πt, discriminant (4Q³−H²)/27. On Q>0 the functionals F±=H±2Q^(3/2) have derivative exactly 3(x(m±√Q)−3π/4)²+9π(16−3π)/16>0. The global inequality m³>9πt, derived from the tangent lower bound to atan and polynomial positivity, forces H<0 on each Q=0 boundary; hence no additional bounded-component crossings. Each F± has precisely one unbounded-component zero α≈1.7602188992, β≈1.8972451274; sign factorization forces exactly 3 distinct negative real roots for α<t<β and single negative root plus a complex pair otherwise. At α,β one double negative root. Numerical root/signed discriminant checks corroborate rather than prove uniqueness.
